blocks.content: The TRAI Act was amended in 2000 to separate regulatory and dispute settlement functions. This led to the creation of the Telecom Disputes Settlement and Appellate Tribunal (TDSAT).
The TRAI Act was amended in 2000 to separate regulatory and dispute settlement functions.

items: TDSAT was created specifically through the 2000 Amendment to the TRAI Act, not the original Act.
Questions frequently test which body handles dispute settlement (TDSAT) versus regulatory functions (TRAI).

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The TRAI Act was officially amended in the year 2000.
The primary mandate of the amendment was separating regulatory responsibilities from dispute settlement.
The amendment directly resulted in the establishment of the Telecom Disputes Settlement and Appellate Tribunal (TDSAT).
